verdict.rationale: Medusa maintains a complete OpenAPI 3.0 spec for its Store REST API, which powers the docs.medusajs.com/api reference, and publishes dedicated Storefront Development Guides. Community users independently confirm it is headless and ships Next.js and Gatsby starter kits. The probe's 404s on guessed OpenAPI paths don't contradict the spec in the repo. missing for 10: hands-on evidence of building a fully custom storefront end-to-end, detailed content of the storefront guides beyond the page title.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build a fully custom headless storefront on a documented storefront API or first-party frontend framework

citations.quote: Medusa maintains complete machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0 specifications for the Store (and Admin) REST APIs in the medusajs/medusa repository; they power the docs.medusajs.com/api reference.
Really love that you have starter kits for both Gatsby and Nextjs
I love the idea of a headless ecommerce platform
